import line = "./line_solver.qui"

bool is_clue_line(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for point := text.codepoints()[]
        if point != 32 and not (48 <= point <= 57)
            return false
    return true

int[] | none parse_clue(string text)
    if text == "0"
        return []
    int[] result := []
    for token := text.split(" ")[]
        if #token < 1 or #token > 2 or token[0] == "0"
            return none
        for point := token.codepoints()[]
            if point < 48 or point > 57
                return none
        result = result.append(int(token))
    return result

int[] run_clue(int[] cells)
    int[] result := []
    run := 0
    for state := cells[]
        if state == line.FILLED
            run += 1
        elif run > 0
            result = result.append(run)
            run = 0
    if run > 0
        result = result.append(run)
    return result

string formatted(int[] clue, string separator)
    if #clue == 0
        return "0"
    string[] tokens := []
    for length := clue[]
        tokens = tokens.append(string(length))
    return tokens.join(separator)

string spaced(int[] clue)
    return formatted(clue, " ")

string comma_separated(int[] clue)
    return formatted(clue, ",")

int total(int[] clue)
    result := 0
    for length := clue[]
        result += length
    return result

bool fits(int[] clue, int length)
    return total(clue) + int(#clue) - 1 <= length

const UNKNOWN := 0
const FILLED := 1
const EMPTY := 2

bool[][] fit_table(int[] cells, int[] clue)
    empties := [0]
    for state := cells[]
        empties = empties.append(empties[-1] + (if state == EMPTY then 1 else 0))
    bool[][] table := []
    for: index <= #cells
        table = table.append(array(#clue + 1, fill = false))
    table[0][0] = true
    for: 1 <= end <= int(#cells)
        for: count <= int(#clue)
            fits := cells[end - 1] != FILLED and table[end - 1][count]
            if not fits and count > 0
                start := end - clue[count - 1]
                if start >= 0 and empties[end] == empties[start]
                    fits = if start == 0 then count == 1 else cells[start - 1] != FILLED and table[start - 1][count - 1]
            table[end][count] = fits
    return table

class Placements(int[] cells, int[] clue)
    length := int(#cells)
    before := fit_table(cells, clue)
    bool[][] after := fit_table(cells[::-1], clue[::-1])

    bool consistent()
        return before[length][#clue]

    bool can_start(int block, int start)
        end := start + clue[block]
        for: start <= index < end
            if cells[index] == EMPTY
                return false
        left := if start == 0 then block == 0 else cells[start - 1] != FILLED and before[start - 1][block]
        rest := int(#clue) - block - 1
        right := if end == length then rest == 0 else cells[end] != FILLED and after[length - end - 1][rest]
        return left and right

    int[] starts(int block)
        int[] result := []
        for: start <= length - clue[block]
            if can_start(block, start)
                result = result.append(start)
        return result

    bool can_be_empty(int index)
        if cells[index] == FILLED
            return false
        count := int(#clue)
        for: blocks <= count
            if before[index][blocks] and after[length - index - 1][count - blocks]
                return true
        return false

class LineResult(bool contradiction, int[] cells)

bool has_placement(int[] cells, int[] clue)
    placements := Placements(cells, clue)
    return placements.consistent()

LineResult solve_line(int[] cells, int[] clue, bool precise)
    placements := Placements(cells, clue)
    if not placements.consistent()
        return LineResult(true, cells)
    solved := cells
    fillable := array(#cells, fill = false)
    covered := array(#cells, fill = false)
    for: block < int(#clue)
        length := clue[block]
        starts := placements.starts(block)
        if precise
            for start := starts[]
                for: start <= index < start + length
                    fillable[index] = true
        else
            low := starts[0]
            high := starts[-1]
            for: high <= index < low + length
                if solved[index] == UNKNOWN
                    solved[index] = FILLED
            for: low <= index < high + length
                covered[index] = true
    for: index < #cells
        if solved[index] != UNKNOWN
            continue
        if precise
            emptiable := placements.can_be_empty(int(index))
            if fillable[index] and not emptiable
                solved[index] = FILLED
            elif emptiable and not fillable[index]
                solved[index] = EMPTY
        elif not covered[index]
            solved[index] = EMPTY
    return LineResult(false, solved)

import collections
import line = "./line_solver.qui"
import clues = "./clues.qui"
import propagation = "./propagation.qui"
import search = "./search.qui"
import render = "./render.qui"

string[][] read_blocks(string path)
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin(path))
    string[][] result := []
    string[] current := []
    inside := false
    for row := text.split(NL)[]
        if not inside
            if row != "" and row[0] != "#"
                current = [row]
                inside = true
        elif row == "END"
            result = result.append(current)
            current = []
            inside = false
        else
            current = current.append(row)
    return result

bool valid_name(string name)
    if #name < 1 or #name > 20
        return false
    for point := name.codepoints()[]
        if not (97 <= point <= 122 or 48 <= point <= 57 or point == 95)
            return false
    return true

string number_list(int[] numbers)
    if #numbers == 0
        return "-"
    string[] values := []
    for number := numbers[]
        values = values.append(string(number))
    return values.join(",")

string cell_text(int row, int column)
    return "{row + 1},{column + 1}"

int[][] state_grid(string[] texts)
    int[][] result := []
    for text := texts[]
        int[] row := []
        for: index < #text
            row = row.append(render.char_state(text[index]))
        result = result.append(row)
    return result

int[][] grid_columns(int[][] grid)
    int[][] result := []
    for: column < #grid[0]
        result = result.append(propagation.line_cells(grid, false, int(column)))
    return result

search.Cell[] differing_cells(int[][] first, int[][] second)
    search.Cell[] result := []
    for: row < #first
        for: column < #first[row]
            if first[row][column] != second[row][column]
                result = result.append(search.Cell(int(row), int(column)))
    return result

class Given(int row, int column, int state)

class RawGiven(int row, int column, string value)

class CheckedClues(int[][] values, string problem)

CheckedClues check_clues(string[] texts, string kind, int length)
    int[][] result := []
    for: index < #texts
        match clues.parse_clue(texts[index])
            int[] clue
                if not clues.fits(clue, length)
                    return CheckedClues([], "{kind} {index + 1} too long")
                result = result.append(clue)
            none
                return CheckedClues([], "bad clue {kind} {index + 1}")
    return CheckedClues(result, "")

class Puzzle(local string[] texts)
    string name := texts[0][7:<#texts[0]]
    local dimensions := texts[1].split(" ")
    width := int(dimensions[1])
    height := int(dimensions[2])
    local columns_at := 3
    while texts[columns_at] != "COLUMNS"
        columns_at += 1
    string[] row_lines := texts[3:<columns_at]
    string[] column_lines := []
    RawGiven[] given_lines := []
    local position := columns_at + 1
    while position < int(#texts) and clues.is_clue_line(texts[position])
        column_lines = column_lines.append(texts[position])
        position += 1
    while position < int(#texts) and texts[position].starts_with("GIVEN ")
        parts := texts[position].split(" ")
        given_lines = given_lines.append(RawGiven(int(parts[1]), int(parts[2]), parts[3]))
        position += 1
    answer_present := position < int(#texts)
    string[] answer_lines := if answer_present then texts[position + 1:<#texts] else []
    int[][] row_clues := []
    int[][] column_clues := []
    Given[] givens := []
    int[][] answer := []

    string .validate(map<string, int> earlier)
        if not valid_name(name)
            return "bad name"
        if earlier.has(name)
            return "duplicate name"
        if width < 1 or width > 30 or height < 1 or height > 30
            return "bad size"
        if int(#row_lines) != height
            return "row count {#row_lines} expected {height}"
        if int(#column_lines) != width
            return "column count {#column_lines} expected {width}"
        rows := check_clues(row_lines, "row", width)
        if rows.problem != ""
            return rows.problem
        row_clues = rows.values
        columns := check_clues(column_lines, "column", height)
        if columns.problem != ""
            return columns.problem
        column_clues = columns.values
        row_total := 0
        column_total := 0
        for clue := row_clues[]
            row_total += clues.total(clue)
        for clue := column_clues[]
            column_total += clues.total(clue)
        if row_total != column_total
            return "total mismatch rows={row_total} columns={column_total}"
        map<string, int> taken
        for: index < #given_lines
            given := given_lines[index]
            if given.row < 1 or given.row > height or given.column < 1 or given.column > width or (given.value != "#" and given.value != ".")
                return "bad given {index + 1}"
            key := "{given.row},{given.column}"
            if taken.has(key)
                return "duplicate given {index + 1}"
            .taken.set(key, 1)
            givens = givens.append(Given(given.row - 1, given.column - 1, render.char_state(given.value)))
        if answer_present
            if int(#answer_lines) != height
                return "bad answer"
            for text := answer_lines[]
                if int(#text) != width
                    return "bad answer"
                for: index < #text
                    if text[index] != "#" and text[index] != "." and text[index] != "?"
                        return "bad answer"
            answer = state_grid(answer_lines)
        return ""

class Picture(local string[] texts)
    string name := texts[0][8:<#texts[0]]
    string[] rows := texts[1:<#texts]

    string validate(map<string, int> earlier)
        if not valid_name(name)
            return "bad name"
        if earlier.has(name)
            return "duplicate name"
        if #rows < 1 or #rows > 30
            return "bad height"
        for: index < #rows
            text := rows[index]
            if #text < 1 or #text > 30 or #text != #rows[0]
                return "bad row {index + 1}"
            for: position < #text
                if text[position] != "#" and text[position] != "."
                    return "bad row {index + 1}"
        return ""

class Logical(int[][] grid, propagation.Result details, string result)

Logical logical_solve(int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues, Given[] givens, bool precise)
    int[][] grid := []
    for: row < #row_clues
        grid = grid.append(array(#column_clues, fill = line.UNKNOWN))
    for given := givens[]
        grid[given.row][given.column] = given.state
    details := propagation.propagate(&grid, row_clues, column_clues, precise, array(#row_clues, fill = true), array(#column_clues, fill = true))
    string result := if details.contradiction then "contradiction at=" + details.conflict.label() elif propagation.determined_count(grid) == int(#row_clues * #column_clues) then "solved" else "stuck"
    return Logical(grid, details, result)

class Analysis(int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues, local Given[] givens)
    simple := logical_solve(row_clues, column_clues, givens, false)
    logic := logical_solve(row_clues, column_clues, givens, true)
    search_result := search.Search(row_clues, column_clues)
    searched := false
    int[][][] solutions := []
    difficulty := "-"
    status := "contradiction"
    if not logic.details.contradiction
        if logic.result == "solved"
            status = "unique"
            solutions = [logic.grid]
            difficulty = if simple.result == "solved" then "easy" else "medium"
        else
            searched = true
            .search_result.run(logic.grid, 1)
            solutions = search_result.solutions
            status = if #solutions == 0 then "none" elif #solutions == 1 then "unique" else "multiple"
            if status == "unique"
                difficulty = "hard"
    int line_solves := int(#logic.details.steps) + search_result.line_solves
    guesses := int(#search_result.guesses)
    int max_depth := search_result.max_depth

string clue_statistics(int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues)
    row_blocks := 0
    column_blocks := 0
    filled := 0
    max_block := 0
    fixed_lines := 0
    for: nat side < 2
        collection := if side == 0 then row_clues else column_clues
        length := if side == 0 then int(#column_clues) else int(#row_clues)
        for clue := collection[]
            if side == 0
                row_blocks += int(#clue)
                filled += clues.total(clue)
            else
                column_blocks += int(#clue)
            if #clue == 0 or clues.total(clue) + int(#clue) - 1 == length
                fixed_lines += 1
            for block := clue[]
                if block > max_block
                    max_block = block
    return "row_blocks={row_blocks} column_blocks={column_blocks} filled={filled} max_block={max_block} fixed_lines={fixed_lines}"

string step_statistics(propagation.Result details)
    productive := 0
    idle := 0
    best := 0
    at := "-"
    for step := details.steps[]
        if step.contradiction
            continue
        if step.gain > 0
            productive += 1
        else
            idle += 1
        if step.gain > best
            best = step.gain
            at = step.label()
    return "productive={productive} idle={idle} best={best} at={at}"

string features_text(int[][] grid)
    height := int(#grid)
    width := int(#grid[0])
    bool[][] seen := []
    for: row < height
        seen = seen.append(array(nat(width), fill = false))
    filled := 0
    components := 0
    largest := 0
    min_row := height
    min_column := width
    max_row := -1
    max_column := -1
    lr := true
    ud := true
    rot180 := true
    int[][] offsets := [[-1, 0], [1, 0], [0, -1], [0, 1]]
    for: row < height
        for: column < width
            lr = lr and grid[row][column] == grid[row][width - 1 - column]
            ud = ud and grid[row][column] == grid[height - 1 - row][column]
            rot180 = rot180 and grid[row][column] == grid[height - 1 - row][width - 1 - column]
            if grid[row][column] != line.FILLED
                continue
            filled += 1
            if row < min_row
                min_row = row
            if row > max_row
                max_row = row
            if column < min_column
                min_column = column
            if column > max_column
                max_column = column
            if seen[row][column]
                continue
            seen[row][column] = true
            stack := [search.Cell(row, column)]
            size := 0
            while #stack != 0
                current := stack[-1]
                stack = stack[0:<#stack - 1]
                size += 1
                for offset := offsets[]
                    next_row := current.row + offset[0]
                    next_column := current.column + offset[1]
                    if next_row < 0 or next_row >= height or next_column < 0 or next_column >= width
                        continue
                    if grid[next_row][next_column] == line.FILLED and not seen[next_row][next_column]
                        seen[next_row][next_column] = true
                        stack = stack.append(search.Cell(next_row, next_column))
            components += 1
            if size > largest
                largest = size
    bbox := if filled == 0 then "-" else "{min_row + 1},{min_column + 1},{max_row + 1},{max_column + 1}"
    string[] symmetries := []
    if lr
        symmetries = symmetries.append("lr")
    if ud
        symmetries = symmetries.append("ud")
    if rot180
        symmetries = symmetries.append("rot180")
    symmetry := if #symmetries == 0 then "none" else symmetries.join(",")
    return "filled={filled} components={components} largest={largest} bbox={bbox} symmetry={symmetry}"

string unknown_summary(int[][] collection)
    string[] parts := []
    for: index < #collection
        count := 0
        for state := collection[index][]
            if state == line.UNKNOWN
                count += 1
        if count > 0
            parts = parts.append("{index + 1}:{count}")
    return parts.join(" ")

string[] search_lines(search.Search result)
    lines := ["search guesses={#result.guesses} max_depth={result.max_depth} backtracks={result.backtracks} solutions={#result.solutions} line_solves={result.line_solves}"]
    for guess := result.guesses[]
        lines = lines.append("guess {guess.number} depth={guess.depth} cell={cell_text(guess.row, guess.column)} value={render.state_char(guess.value)} solves={guess.solves} known={guess.known} result={guess.result}")
    return lines

string[] display_lines(Analysis analyzed)
    string[] names := []
    int[][][] grids := []
    if analyzed.status == "contradiction"
        names = ["partial"]
        grids = [analyzed.logic.grid]
    else
        if analyzed.simple.result == "stuck"
            names = names.append("simple")
            grids = grids.append(analyzed.simple.grid)
        if analyzed.logic.result == "stuck"
            names = names.append("logic")
            grids = grids.append(analyzed.logic.grid)
        if analyzed.status == "multiple"
            names = names.concat(["first", "second"])
            grids = grids.concat(analyzed.solutions)
    return if #names == 0 then [] else render.grid_display(names, grids)

string evaluate_givens(Puzzle puzzle, Analysis analyzed)
    if #puzzle.givens == 0 or analyzed.status == "multiple"
        return ""
    label := if analyzed.status == "unique" then "redundant" else "blame"
    int[] numbers := []
    for: index < #puzzle.givens
        Given[] others := puzzle.givens[0:<index].concat(puzzle.givens[index + 1:<#puzzle.givens])
        trial := Analysis(puzzle.row_clues, puzzle.column_clues, others)
        if trial.status == "unique" or (analyzed.status != "unique" and trial.status == "multiple")
            numbers = numbers.append(int(index) + 1)
    return "givens {label}={number_list(numbers)}"

class Grading(string result, string[] lines)

Grading grade_answer(Puzzle puzzle, Analysis analyzed)
    int[] rows := []
    int[] columns := []
    int[] givens := []
    for: row < puzzle.height
        if not line.has_placement(puzzle.answer[row], puzzle.row_clues[row])
            rows = rows.append(row + 1)
    for: column < puzzle.width
        if not line.has_placement(propagation.line_cells(puzzle.answer, false, column), puzzle.column_clues[column])
            columns = columns.append(column + 1)
    bool[][] given_cells := []
    for: row < puzzle.height
        given_cells = given_cells.append(array(nat(puzzle.width), fill = false))
    for: index < #puzzle.givens
        given := puzzle.givens[index]
        given_cells[given.row][given.column] = true
        state := puzzle.answer[given.row][given.column]
        if state != line.UNKNOWN and state != given.state
            givens = givens.append(int(index) + 1)
    known := propagation.determined_count(puzzle.answer)
    mismatched := #rows > 0 or #columns > 0 or #givens > 0
    result := if known < puzzle.width * puzzle.height then "partial" elif mismatched then "wrong" else "correct"
    text := "answer result={result} known={known} rows={number_list(rows)} columns={number_list(columns)} givens={number_list(givens)}"
    if result == "partial"
        extendable := "no"
        if not mismatched
            additions := puzzle.givens
            for: row < puzzle.height
                for: column < puzzle.width
                    state := puzzle.answer[row][column]
                    if state != line.UNKNOWN and not given_cells[row][column]
                        additions = additions.append(Given(row, column, state))
            trial := Analysis(puzzle.row_clues, puzzle.column_clues, additions)
            if trial.status == "unique" or trial.status == "multiple"
                extendable = "yes"
        text += " extendable={extendable}"
    if analyzed.status == "unique"
        differs := 0
        for: row < puzzle.height
            for: column < puzzle.width
                state := puzzle.answer[row][column]
                if state != line.UNKNOWN and state != analyzed.solutions[0][row][column]
                    differs += 1
        text += " differs={differs}"
    lines := [text]
    for: side < 2
        mismatches := if side == 0 then rows else columns
        for number := mismatches[]
            index := number - 1
            is_row := side == 0
            clue := if is_row then puzzle.row_clues[index] else puzzle.column_clues[index]
            cells := propagation.line_cells(puzzle.answer, is_row, index)
            suffix := if result == "partial" then "cells=" + render.state_string(cells) else "got=" + clues.comma_separated(clues.run_clue(cells))
            lines = lines.append("mismatch {propagation.line_label(is_row, index)} expected={clues.comma_separated(clue)} {suffix}")
    return Grading(result, lines)

class Report(Puzzle puzzle)
    analyzed := Analysis(puzzle.row_clues, puzzle.column_clues, puzzle.givens)
    evaluation := evaluate_givens(puzzle, analyzed)
    Grading grading := if puzzle.answer_present then grade_answer(puzzle, analyzed) else Grading("-", [])

    int score()
        return analyzed.line_solves + 25 * analyzed.guesses

    string[] paragraph()
        lines := [
            "PUZZLE " + puzzle.name,
            "size={puzzle.width}x{puzzle.height} givens={#puzzle.givens} status={analyzed.status} difficulty={analyzed.difficulty}",
            "clues " + clue_statistics(puzzle.row_clues, puzzle.column_clues),
            "simple known={propagation.determined_count(analyzed.simple.grid)} line_solves={#analyzed.simple.details.steps} result={analyzed.simple.result}",
            "logic known={propagation.determined_count(analyzed.logic.grid)} line_solves={#analyzed.logic.details.steps} result={analyzed.logic.result}",
            "steps " + step_statistics(analyzed.logic.details)
        ]
        if puzzle.width * puzzle.height <= 49
            lines = lines.append("trace " + analyzed.logic.details.record())
        if analyzed.logic.result == "stuck"
            lines = lines.append("stuck rows={unknown_summary(analyzed.logic.grid)} columns={unknown_summary(grid_columns(analyzed.logic.grid))}")
        if analyzed.status == "contradiction"
            propagation.Step conflict := analyzed.logic.details.conflict
            clue := if conflict.is_row then puzzle.row_clues[conflict.index] else puzzle.column_clues[conflict.index]
            cells := propagation.line_cells(analyzed.logic.grid, conflict.is_row, conflict.index)
            lines = lines.append("conflict line={conflict.label()} clue={clues.comma_separated(clue)} cells={render.state_string(cells)}")
        if analyzed.searched
            lines = lines.concat(search_lines(analyzed.search_result))
        if analyzed.status == "multiple"
            cells := differing_cells(analyzed.solutions[0], analyzed.solutions[1])
            string[] listed := []
            for cell := cells[]
                listed = listed.append(cell_text(cell.row, cell.column))
            values := listed.join(" ")
            lines = lines.append("differ count={#cells} cells={values}")
        lines = lines.concat(display_lines(analyzed))
        if analyzed.status == "unique"
            lines = lines.append("sheet")
            lines = lines.concat(render.answer_sheet(puzzle.row_clues, puzzle.column_clues, analyzed.solutions[0]))
            lines = lines.append("picture " + features_text(analyzed.solutions[0]))
        if evaluation != ""
            lines = lines.append(evaluation)
        if puzzle.answer_present
            lines = lines.concat(grading.lines)
        return lines

    string stats_row()
        string[] fields := [puzzle.name, analyzed.status, analyzed.difficulty, string(puzzle.width), string(puzzle.height), string(#puzzle.givens), string(propagation.determined_count(analyzed.simple.grid)), string(propagation.determined_count(analyzed.logic.grid)), string(analyzed.line_solves), string(analyzed.guesses), string(analyzed.max_depth), string(#analyzed.solutions), grading.result]
        return fields.join(",")

int difficulty_order(string difficulty)
    return if difficulty == "easy" then 0 elif difficulty == "medium" then 1 else 2

bool report_before(Report first, Report second)
    left := difficulty_order(first.analyzed.difficulty)
    right := difficulty_order(second.analyzed.difficulty)
    if left != right
        return left < right
    if first.score() != second.score()
        return first.score() < second.score()
    return collections.lex_compare(first.puzzle.name.codepoints(), second.puzzle.name.codepoints()) < 0

string[] ranking_lines(Report[] reports)
    Report[] ranked := []
    for report := reports[]
        if report.analyzed.status == "unique"
            ranked = ranked.append(report)
    for: 1 <= index < int(#ranked)
        entry := ranked[index]
        position := index
        while position > 0 and report_before(entry, ranked[position - 1])
            ranked[position] = ranked[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        ranked[position] = entry
    lines := ["RANKING"]
    for: index < #ranked
        entry := ranked[index]
        lines = lines.append("rank {index + 1} {entry.puzzle.name} {entry.analyzed.difficulty} score={entry.score()} size={entry.puzzle.width}x{entry.puzzle.height}")
    return lines

string[] join_paragraphs(string[][] paragraphs)
    string[] result := []
    for paragraph := paragraphs[]
        if #result > 0
            result = result.append("")
        result = result.concat(paragraph)
    return result

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    if not file.is_directory("output")
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(text)

Report[] process_puzzles(string[][] blocks)
    map<string, int> earlier
    Report[] reports := []
    string[][] paragraphs := []
    stats := ["puzzle,status,difficulty,width,height,givens,simple_known,logic_known,line_solves,guesses,max_depth,solutions,answer"]
    for block := blocks[]
        puzzle := Puzzle(block)
        problem := .puzzle.validate(earlier)
        .earlier.set(puzzle.name, 1)
        if problem != ""
            paragraphs = paragraphs.append(["PUZZLE " + puzzle.name, "error " + problem])
            invalid := puzzle.name + ",invalid"
            for: index < 11
                invalid += ",-"
            stats = stats.append(invalid)
        else
            report := Report(puzzle)
            reports = reports.append(report)
            paragraphs = paragraphs.append(report.paragraph())
            stats = stats.append(report.stats_row())
    statuses := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    difficulties := [0, 0, 0]
    status_names := ["contradiction", "none", "unique", "multiple"]
    difficulty_names := ["easy", "medium", "hard"]
    line_solves := 0
    guesses := 0
    for report := reports[]
        for: index < #status_names
            if report.analyzed.status == status_names[index]
                statuses[index] += 1
        for: index < #difficulty_names
            if report.analyzed.difficulty == difficulty_names[index]
                difficulties[index] += 1
        line_solves += report.analyzed.line_solves
        guesses += report.analyzed.guesses
    paragraphs = paragraphs.append(ranking_lines(reports))
    paragraphs = paragraphs.append(["SUMMARY puzzles={#blocks} invalid={int(#blocks) - int(#reports)} contradiction={statuses[0]} none={statuses[1]} unique={statuses[2]} multiple={statuses[3]} easy={difficulties[0]} medium={difficulties[1]} hard={difficulties[2]} line_solves={line_solves} guesses={guesses}"])
    write_lines("solutions.txt", join_paragraphs(paragraphs))
    write_lines("stats.csv", stats)
    return reports

Given[] sorted_givens(Given[] givens)
    result := givens
    for: 1 <= index < int(#result)
        entry := result[index]
        position := index
        while position > 0
            previous := result[position - 1]
            if previous.row < entry.row or (previous.row == entry.row and previous.column <= entry.column)
                break
            result[position] = previous
            position -= 1
        result[position] = entry
    return result

class Generation(int[][] grid)
    int[][] row_clues := []
    int[][] column_clues := []
    for row := grid[]
        row_clues = row_clues.append(clues.run_clue(row))
    for column := grid_columns(grid)[]
        column_clues = column_clues.append(clues.run_clue(column))
    Given[] givens := []
    string[] log := []
    initial := Analysis(row_clues, column_clues, givens)
    local Analysis current := initial
    while current.status == "multiple"
        differences := differing_cells(current.solutions[0], current.solutions[1])
        chosen := differences[0]
        state := grid[chosen.row][chosen.column]
        givens = givens.append(Given(chosen.row, chosen.column, state))
        current = Analysis(row_clues, column_clues, givens)
        log = log.append("# hint {#givens} cell={cell_text(chosen.row, chosen.column)} value={render.state_char(state)} status={current.status}")
    local original := givens
    for given := original[]
        Given[] others := []
        for other := givens[]
            if other.row != given.row or other.column != given.column
                others = others.append(other)
        trial := Analysis(row_clues, column_clues, others)
        if trial.status == "unique"
            givens = others
            log = log.append("# drop cell={cell_text(given.row, given.column)}")
    final_analysis := Analysis(row_clues, column_clues, givens)
    local logic_hints := 0
    while final_analysis.difficulty == "hard"
        chosen := search.guess_cell(final_analysis.logic.grid)
        state := grid[chosen.row][chosen.column]
        givens = givens.append(Given(chosen.row, chosen.column, state))
        final_analysis = Analysis(row_clues, column_clues, givens)
        logic_hints += 1
        log = log.append("# logic hint {logic_hints} cell={cell_text(chosen.row, chosen.column)} value={render.state_char(state)} difficulty={final_analysis.difficulty}")

    string[] puzzle_lines(string name)
        lines := ["PUZZLE " + name, "SIZE {#column_clues} {#row_clues}", "ROWS"]
        for clue := row_clues[]
            lines = lines.append(clues.spaced(clue))
        lines = lines.append("COLUMNS")
        for clue := column_clues[]
            lines = lines.append(clues.spaced(clue))
        for given := sorted_givens(givens)[]
            lines = lines.append("GIVEN {given.row + 1} {given.column + 1} {render.state_char(given.state)}")
        return lines.append("END")

string same_clues_name(Report[] reports, int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues)
    for report := reports[]
        if report.puzzle.row_clues == row_clues and report.puzzle.column_clues == column_clues
            return report.puzzle.name
    return "-"

string[] picture_paragraph(Picture picture, Generation generation, Report[] reports)
    Analysis initial := generation.initial
    Analysis final_analysis := generation.final_analysis
    duplicate := same_clues_name(reports, generation.row_clues, generation.column_clues)
    lines := [
        "# picture {picture.name} size={#generation.grid[0]}x{#generation.grid} {features_text(generation.grid)}",
        "# clues {clue_statistics(generation.row_clues, generation.column_clues)} duplicate_of={duplicate}",
        "# plain status={initial.status} difficulty={initial.difficulty} line_solves={initial.line_solves} guesses={initial.guesses}"
    ]
    lines = lines.concat(generation.log)
    lines = lines.append("# final status={final_analysis.status} difficulty={final_analysis.difficulty} hints={#generation.givens} line_solves={final_analysis.line_solves} guesses={final_analysis.guesses}")
    return lines.concat(generation.puzzle_lines(picture.name))

void process_pictures(string[][] blocks, Report[] reports)
    map<string, int> earlier
    string[][] paragraphs := []
    valid := 0
    unique := 0
    line_logic := 0
    hinted := 0
    hints := 0
    for block := blocks[]
        picture := Picture(block)
        problem := picture.validate(earlier)
        .earlier.set(picture.name, 1)
        if problem != ""
            paragraphs = paragraphs.append(["# picture {picture.name} error {problem}"])
            continue
        generation := Generation(state_grid(picture.rows))
        valid += 1
        if generation.initial.status == "unique"
            unique += 1
        if generation.initial.difficulty == "easy" or generation.initial.difficulty == "medium"
            line_logic += 1
        if #generation.givens > 0
            hinted += 1
        hints += int(#generation.givens)
        paragraphs = paragraphs.append(picture_paragraph(picture, generation, reports))
    paragraphs = paragraphs.append(["# SUMMARY pictures={#blocks} invalid={int(#blocks) - valid} unique={unique} line_logic={line_logic} hinted={hinted} hints={hints}"])
    write_lines("generated.txt", join_paragraphs(paragraphs))

if main
    reports := process_puzzles(read_blocks("input/puzzles.txt"))
    process_pictures(read_blocks("input/pictures.txt"), reports)

import line = "./line_solver.qui"

string line_label(bool is_row, int index)
    prefix := if is_row then "R" else "C"
    return prefix + string(index + 1)

int[] line_cells(int[][] grid, bool is_row, int index)
    if is_row
        return grid[index]
    int[] result := []
    for row := grid[]
        result = result.append(row[index])
    return result

int determined_count(int[][] grid)
    result := 0
    for row := grid[]
        for state := row[]
            if state != line.UNKNOWN
                result += 1
    return result

class Step(bool is_row, int index, int gain, bool contradiction)
    string label()
        return line_label(is_row, index)

    string text()
        return label() + (if contradiction then "!" else "+" + string(gain))

class Result()
    Step[] steps := []
    contradiction := false
    conflict := Step(true, 0, 0, false)

    string record()
        string[] parts := []
        for step := steps[]
            parts = parts.append(step.text())
        return parts.join(" ")

Result propagate(int[][] &grid, int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues, bool precise, bool[] row_marks, bool[] column_marks)
    result := Result()
    while true
        is_row := true
        chosen := -1
        for: index < #row_marks
            if row_marks[index]
                chosen = int(index)
                break
        if chosen < 0
            is_row = false
            for: index < #column_marks
                if column_marks[index]
                    chosen = int(index)
                    break
        if chosen < 0
            return result
        int[] clue
        if is_row
            row_marks[chosen] = false
            clue = row_clues[chosen]
        else
            column_marks[chosen] = false
            clue = column_clues[chosen]
        cells := line_cells(grid, is_row, chosen)
        solved := line.solve_line(cells, clue, precise)
        if solved.contradiction
            result.contradiction = true
            result.conflict = Step(is_row, chosen, 0, true)
            result.steps = result.steps.append(result.conflict)
            return result
        gain := 0
        for: position < #cells
            if cells[position] == line.UNKNOWN and solved.cells[position] != line.UNKNOWN
                gain += 1
                if is_row
                    grid[chosen][position] = solved.cells[position]
                    column_marks[position] = true
                else
                    grid[position][chosen] = solved.cells[position]
                    row_marks[position] = true
        result.steps = result.steps.append(Step(is_row, chosen, gain, false))

import clues = "./clues.qui"

string state_char(int state)
    return if state == line.FILLED then "#" elif state == line.EMPTY then "." else "?"

int char_state(string character)
    return if character == "#" then line.FILLED elif character == "." then line.EMPTY else line.UNKNOWN

string state_string(int[] cells)
    result := ""
    for state := cells[]
        result += state_char(state)
    return result

string[] grid_display(string[] names, int[][][] grids)
    lines := ["grid " + names.join(" ")]
    for: row < #grids[0]
        string[] parts := []
        for grid := grids[]
            parts = parts.append(state_string(grid[row]))
        lines = lines.append(parts.join(" | "))
    return lines

string pad_left(string text, int width)
    result := text
    while int(#result) < width
        result = " " + result
    return result

string trim_right(string text)
    end := int(#text)
    while end > 0 and text[end - 1] == " "
        end -= 1
    return text[0:<end]

string[] answer_sheet(int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues, int[][] grid)
    string[][] tokens := []
    width := 0
    depth := 0
    margin := 0
    for clue := column_clues[]
        column := clues.spaced(clue).split(" ")
        tokens = tokens.append(column)
        if int(#column) > depth
            depth = int(#column)
        for token := column[]
            if int(#token) + 1 > width
                width = int(#token) + 1
    for clue := row_clues[]
        length := int(#clues.spaced(clue))
        if length > margin
            margin = length
    string[] result := []
    for: row < depth
        string text := " " * nat(margin)
        for column := tokens[]
            skipped := depth - int(#column)
            text += if row >= skipped then pad_left(column[row - skipped], width) else " " * nat(width)
        result = result.append(trim_right(text))
    for: row < #grid
        text := pad_left(clues.spaced(row_clues[row]), margin)
        for state := grid[row][]
            text += " " * nat(width - 1) + state_char(state)
        result = result.append(text)
    return result

import line = "./line_solver.qui"
import propagation = "./propagation.qui"

class Cell(int row, int column)

Cell guess_cell(int[][] grid)
    row_unknowns := array(#grid, fill = 0)
    column_unknowns := array(#grid[0], fill = 0)
    for: row < #grid
        for: column < #grid[row]
            if grid[row][column] == line.UNKNOWN
                row_unknowns[row] += 1
                column_unknowns[column] += 1
    best := Cell(-1, -1)
    best_score := 0
    for: row < #grid
        for: column < #grid[row]
            if grid[row][column] == line.UNKNOWN
                score := row_unknowns[row] + column_unknowns[column]
                if best.row < 0 or score < best_score
                    best = Cell(int(row), int(column))
                    best_score = score
    return best

class Guess(int number, int depth, int row, int column, int value, int solves, int known, string result)

class Search(int[][] row_clues, int[][] column_clues)
    Guess[] guesses := []
    int[][][] solutions := []
    backtracks := 0
    max_depth := 0
    line_solves := 0

    bool .run(int[][] grid, int depth)
        chosen := guess_cell(grid)
        for value := [line.FILLED, line.EMPTY][]
            number := int(#guesses) + 1
            if depth > max_depth
                max_depth = depth
            child := grid
            child[chosen.row][chosen.column] = value
            row_marks := array(#row_clues, fill = false)
            column_marks := array(#column_clues, fill = false)
            row_marks[chosen.row] = true
            column_marks[chosen.column] = true
            propagated := propagation.propagate(&child, row_clues, column_clues, true, row_marks, column_marks)
            known := propagation.determined_count(child)
            result := "open"
            if propagated.contradiction
                result = "contradiction at=" + propagated.conflict.label()
                backtracks += 1
            elif known == int(#row_clues * #column_clues)
                solutions = solutions.append(child)
                result = "solution{#solutions}"
            solves := int(#propagated.steps)
            line_solves += solves
            guesses = guesses.append(Guess(number, depth, chosen.row, chosen.column, value, solves, known, result))
            if result == "open"
                if .run(child, depth + 1)
                    return true
            elif #solutions == 2
                return true
        return false
